contentitemdata.dancinggoat.articlepage.ArticlePageSummary: Cold brew is slow, forgiving, and hard to mess up. All you need is a jar, coarse coffee, cold water, and a little patience.
contentitemdata.dancinggoat.articlepage.ArticlePageText:
Cold brew is the easiest coffee you'll ever make. There's no kettle, no timer, and no fancy gear — just ground coffee, water, and time.

What you need

  • 100 g of coarsely ground coffee
  • 1 liter of cold, filtered water
  • A large jar and a paper or cloth filter

How to make it

Stir the coffee into the water, cover the jar, and leave it in the fridge for 16 to 20 hours. Strain it through the filter, and you've got a smooth concentrate that keeps for up to a week.

Dilute it 1:1 with water or milk and pour it over ice. We like a washed Central American coffee for this — it brings out chocolate and caramel without any bitterness.
